name: Wooden Ornament Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material: 
    Crafted from premium 3mm thick wood, durable, sturdy, and eco-friendly.

 

  • Sizes and Dimensions: 
    - 1 Compartment Box: 4.21 × 4.21 × 1.24  in ~ 10.69 × 10.69 × 3.15 cm, holds up to 4 ornaments.
    - 2 Compartment Box: 8.32 in × 4.21 in × 1.24 in ~ 21.13 × 10.69 × 3.15 cm, holds up to 8 ornaments.
    - 4 Compartment Box: 8.32 in × 8.32 in × 1.24 in ~ 21.13 × 21.13 × 3.15 cm, holds up to 16 ornaments.
    - 6 Compartment Box: 12.43 in × 8.32 in × 1.24 in ~ 31.56 × 21.13 × 3.15 cm, holds up to 24 ornaments.
    - Maximum ornament size: 4 × 4 in ~ 10 × 10 cm
    📌 Note: The storage box comes flat-packed and requires assembly.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    Advanced UV printing technology with sharp, vivid, and long-lasting colors. Designs are printed double-sided for a premium finish.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    📌 Storage & Organization: Keeps ornaments safely stored in separate compartments, preventing scratches, dust, and damage.
    📌 Display & Presentation: With beautifully printed or laser-cut designs on the lid, the box doubles as a decorative piece to showcase during the holiday season.
    📌 Reusable & Durable: Strong wooden structure allows repeated use year after year, making it an eco-friendly storage solution.
    📌 Easy Assembly & Portability: Flat-packed design makes it simple to assemble and convenient to store when not in use. Lightweight yet sturdy for easy carrying.
    📌 Multi-Purpose Use: Besides Christmas ornaments, the box can also store jewelry, keepsakes, small gifts, or other decorative items.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion: 
    A meaningful and practical gift suitable for everyone, making it perfect for Christmas, New Year, birthdays, weddings, or any festive occasion.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Wooden Ornament Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
